title: The Black Friday Brawl
titleAccent: Ajax Climbs Out of the Basement
dates: Friday, November 27, 2026 · 6 PM Mountain to just past midnight
dek: Twenty-three clubs, double elimination, no match clock. N*S lost once, dropped to the losers bracket, then won five straight elimination games and took the grand final twice to win the first big brawl of the relaunch.

card.name: Ajax Assassins · N*S
card.line: Champion · 7–1 · 105 runs · Field of Dreams stadium

chapters.title: Twenty-three clubs, one rule change
text: The Black Friday Brawl opened with 23 clubs from 17 owners, random seeds, double elimination, and something new: no match clock. Either club could start the game, and people got grace if they stepped away for a minute.
The #1 seed went to ArchHen's Flying Lavender Zebras. QUILL's Green Sox were #2, N*S and Ajax Assassins #3, and Slip's Terrapin Station #4. Nine seeds had first-round byes.

chapters.title: Small clubs, big nerve
text: The first round belonged to the little guys. Jacksonyoung's 3★ Maple Heights Mustangs beat Band of Bands 6–2, superbeast.65's 5★ Small Ballers beat ZigZags 5–2, and Ecky's 4★ Pure Sadness took out Kingdom Keys.
diablow89's UT Legends won the tightest opener of the night, 1–0 over Trump Train.

chapters.title: The upset that set the table
text: The top seeds rolled: Flying Lavender Zebras 21–0, Ajax 16–2, Terrapin 11–0. The #2 seed didn't: ArchHen's second club, TBA -XsT-, beat Green Sox 10–0.
Then the shot of the round. Mr.Crowley's #11 Infidels knocked off #6 LSU Fighting Tigers 12–10, and in the quarterfinal they nearly did it again, losing to Ajax just 11–9.

chapters.title: Ajax goes down
text: Terrapin Station beat the #1 seed Flying Lavender Zebras 12–2. On the other side, TBA -XsT- beat Ajax 11–4 and sent N*S to the losers bracket, one more loss from going home.
TBA -XsT- then edged Terrapin 3–1 in the winners final and waited in the grand final.

chapters.title: LSU's long way back
text: After the Infidels upset, Supr_65's LSU Fighting Tigers went on a tear: 29–0 over Kingdom Keys, 10–8 over Turtles All the Way Down, a 13–9 rematch win over Infidels, and 11–1 over Trump Train. 78 runs, four straight elimination wins.
Rgbartley's Sandlot Bully put up the biggest score of the night, 37–0 over Maple Heights, and Jwizz's Immortal Hostilians won two straight 2–1 thrillers.

chapters.title: The climb out
text: Ajax ended LSU's run 23–5. Against Flying Lavender Zebras no game was played; the organizer recorded it 7–0 and Ajax moved on. Then Ajax beat Terrapin 11–3 in the losers final, and Slip's run ended in third place.

chapters.title: Twice in a row
text: Ajax came into the grand final needing to beat TBA -XsT- twice. They won the first 15–1 to force the reset, then won it again 18–7. N*S finished 7–1 with 105 runs and the only club that beat them all night went home second.

chapters.title: Prizes and a chat crown
text: Ajax Assassins won the Field of Dreams stadium. Quick Trains went to both grand finalists, Ajax and TBA -XsT-. Small Ballers (5★) took the Batting Camp as the best club at 6★ and under.
The chat voted Mr.Crowley the MVC, Most Valuable Chatter. He earned it on the field too: Infidels finished 9th after the LSU upset, and Trump Train won four games to finish 8th.
Because Ajax won the Brawl, N*S opened Hold the Hill Season 1 as the Ace.
